title: API request timeout on document retrieval
description: Our team is unable to load documents via the API. Requests to GET /api/v2/documents/:id are returning 504 Gateway Timeout after 30 seconds. This is blocking our automated document processing pipeline. Started occurring around 1pm UTC today.

title: Dashboard loading extremely slowly
description: The document management dashboard is taking over 20 seconds to load the document list. Previously it loaded in under 2 seconds. Multiple team members are affected. We are on the Enterprise plan and this is impacting our daily operations.

title: Intermittent 504 errors on document export
description: We're getting sporadic 504 errors when trying to export documents via the bulk export API. About 3 out of 5 requests fail. The ones that succeed take much longer than usual (15-20 seconds vs the normal 2-3 seconds).

title: Document search results delayed
description: Search queries in the document finder are taking 8-10 seconds to return results. This has been happening since this morning. Not a complete outage but significantly impacting our team's productivity.

title: Slow response times across all API endpoints
description: General slowness across all Folio API endpoints since approximately noon today. Our integration tests are failing due to timeout thresholds being exceeded. We rely on the API for our CRM integration and deals are being delayed.

title: Minor delay in document preview rendering
description: Document previews are taking a couple extra seconds to render in the browser. Not a huge deal but noticeable compared to yesterday. Just flagging in case it's related to a larger issue.
